description: This file defines a final class 'FeatureDeletedStrategy' which handles the 'FeatureDeleted' event within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy to process feature deletion events on a 'Thing', utilizing 'ThingBuilder' to modify the state.

classes.name: FeatureDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a strategy to handle 'FeatureDeleted' events by removing the specified feature from a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a 'FeatureDeleted' event to a 'ThingBuilder', removing the feature indicated by the event.
